# Each scenario file's seconds on CI's runners, by which ci.yml deals the
# scenario files out over its parts evenly: the longest of each file's four
# runs in slice 11e's CI (00593ec's and 4e94deb's, each on its push and its
# pull request), the same tests each time. A file's time can differ by more
# than the runners' overall speed: test_apollo_10.gd took 218 and 269 s on
# 00593ec's runners and 369 and 368 s on 4e94deb's, the flight printing
# alike each time, while the files beside it took the same time on both.
# The parts went from ten to eleven in 4e94deb, when a part dealt at 514 s
# took 9 min 53 s on the slower runner. test_apollo_12.gd, alone in its
# part, sets that part's time.
# A file not listed counts 60 s.
# Add a new file's time once CI has run it, and measure again when the
# parts drift apart. Slice 12a's three Apollo 14 files carry estimates,
# their local times times 0.75, and the parts went to twelve with them.
